subject.title: test(feishu): lock timeoutMs preflight abort for stalled DNS lookup

question: Should this test-only regression receive a real-behavior-proof override once focused checks pass, or must the contributor supply a standalone stalled-preflight runtime transcript?
rationale: The patch has no production behavior delta to demonstrate after the fix, while the repository's external-PR policy still makes real behavior proof a merge gate unless a maintainer explicitly overrides it.

options.title: Override Test-Only Proof
options.body: Record a proof override after focused checks pass because the PR only locks an already-existing production contract and introduces no runtime change.

options.title: Request Standalone Transcript
options.body: Require a redacted terminal run invoking the production registration path with a deliberately stalled lookup outside Vitest before merge.

recommendation.title: Override Test-Only Proof
recommendation.body: Record a proof override after focused checks pass because the PR only locks an already-existing production contract and introduces no runtime change.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision concerns proof expectations for the Feishu plugin's app-registration test boundary.
